# awx_settings_debug (Data Source)

Reads the AWX `/api/v2/settings/debug/` endpoint.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `awx_cleanup_paths` (Boolean) Enable or Disable TMP Dir cleanup
- `awx_request_profile` (Boolean) Debug web request python timing
- `receptor_release_work` (Boolean) Release receptor work
